name: Lock screen
description: ext-session-lock screen with a clock and a password field, authenticated through PAM, with fingerprint unlock when a finger is enrolled

pamConfig.description: PAM service name used to check the password

pamConfigDirectory.description: Directory holding the PAM service file

preview.description: Debug: lock() shows the lock UI in a normal overlay window and never locks the session (Escape closes it)

fingerprint.description: Offer fingerprint unlock (pam_fprintd) when the fingerprint PAM service exists and fprintd has a finger enrolled for the user

fingerprintPamConfig.description: PAM service name used for fingerprint unlock, in pamConfigDirectory; written by haseen setup fingerprint

fingerprintStallMs.description: A fingerprint attempt that neither shows a message nor ends within this many ms is aborted and retried as a failure (a hung PAM conversation)
